text: 随着乌克兰的袭击导致工业设施瘫痪、物流受阻并加剧了通胀压力，俄罗斯经济正显现出增长放缓的迹象。根据机构对经济学家进行的调查，俄罗斯第三季度GDP同比增速预计为0.9%，低于前一季度1.3%的增幅。这种放缓态势与俄罗斯央行此前的警告相吻合，即无人机袭击正在削弱多个行业的生产能力。根据俄联邦统计局的数据，受炼油厂停产影响，第三季度炼油产量同比下降18%，创下自2020年以来季度数据的最大跌幅。燃料产量的减少加剧了采矿业的萎缩，并导致批发贸易陷入负增长。此外，乌方的袭击还破坏了装卸码头和港口基础设施，对出口造成了拖累。牛津经济研究院的Tatiana Orlov
text_en: As Ukrainian attacks paralyze industrial facilities, disrupt logistics and intensify inflationary pressure, Russia's economy is showing signs of slowing growth. According to a survey of economists by institutions, Russia's Q3 GDP growth is expected at 0.9% year on year, down from 1.3% in the previous quarter. This slowdown is consistent with the Russian central bank's earlier warning that drone attacks are weakening production capacity in multiple industries. According to Federal State Statistics Service data, refinery output fell 18% year on year in Q3 due to refinery shutdowns, the largest quarterly decline since 2020. The reduction in fuel output has exacerbated the contraction in mining and pushed wholesale trade into negative growth. In addition, Ukrainian attacks have also damaged loading docks and port infrastructure, weighing on exports. Tatiana Orlov of Oxford Economics
